summary: Hanmi Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $55.0 million in 6.50% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 via a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). Proceeds will redeem its outstanding $110.0 million 3.75% subordinated notes due 2031 and for general corporate purposes. The notes qualify as Tier 2 capital, mature July 31, 2036, and convert to a floating rate at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 234 basis points after July 31, 2031. This is a routine capital management transaction, not a special situation.
